source: Wang et al., OpenPINN/PINO, Sec. 5.3 (attachment of Professor Rabczuk, 19 Nov 2026); their reference is one FEM mesh, h = 0.025
adapter_description: Plate with a hole: 2 m x 2 m plate, circular hole of radius 0.25 m centred at (1,1), plane stress, small-strain linear elasticity, E = 210 GPa, nu = 0.3. Left edge x = 0 fixed; right edge x = 2 loaded by a uniform traction t_x = 1 MPa; top, bottom and hole traction-free. Q2 (9-node) elements on a structured polar mesh around the hole (8m elements around, 3m radially, m = 2, 4, ..., 64, h = 1/m), mid-side nodes on the exact circle; strategies at m = 16: radial grading toward the hole g = 1.5, 2.0. QoIs: u_right_mid = u_x at (2,1); v_top_right = u_y at (2,2); max_disp_mag over the nodes; strain_energy = 1/2 u.K u; hole_avg_sigma_xx = weighted mean of sigma_xx over the Gauss points within 0.1 of the hole top (1,1.25); hole_gk_avg_sigma_xx = the same with the weight exp(-(d/0.05)^2); hole_peak_sigma_xx = max sigma_xx within 0.1 of the hole top (a smooth finite-radius concentration); peak_von_mises = max von Mises over all Gauss points. The fixed left edge meets the free top and bottom edges at 90-degree clamped/free corners (singular in plane stress); the hole is far from them. No surrogate errors are recorded for this case; the OpenPINN surrogate errors (relative L2 of displacement 3.5-6.3%) are against a single FEM mesh.

theory.note: Q2 elements, lam < 2: the corner limits the global rate to 2 lam (pollution); quantities at the hole are smooth locally but polluted by the corners, so their order is at most about 2 lam

known_rule_limitation_stated_in_advance: The rules classify by QoI class and problem regularity only. In a singular problem every pointwise_peak gets the singular-order check (slope lam - 1). hole_peak_sigma_xx is a peak at a smooth, finite-radius concentration far from the corners: it is expected to CONVERGE, so the singular-order gate is expected to FAIL for it although nothing is wrong. The rules do not know where a peak is; the diagnosis engine (location, h-trend) should separate the two peaks.

developer_expectations.u_right_mid, v_top_right, max_disp_mag: PASS with rate; fitted order >= 2 lam - 0.15 = 1.37
developer_expectations.strain_energy: PASS with rate; order 2 lam = 1.52 within 0.15
developer_expectations.hole_avg_sigma_xx: PASS (band or rate): sharp disc, Gauss points enter and leave the region between levels
developer_expectations.hole_peak_sigma_xx: convergence PASS (bounded, converging; order about 1 from the Gauss-point offset from the hole surface, at most about 2 lam); singular_order FAIL (not a corner peak); located at the hole top (1, 1.25) within 0.05
developer_expectations.peak_von_mises: convergence FAIL (grows); log-log slope lam - 1 = -0.242 within 0.15; located at a clamped/free corner (0,0) or (0,2)
